name: Layout 4: 5-Choices (A-E), Short Math Stems & 2-Choice True/False
text:
Section 1: Advanced Mathematics and Logic

1. Solve $2x = 8$.
(a) 1
(b) 2
(c) 3
(d) 4
(e) 5

2. Evaluate $\sqrt{49}$.
(a) 5
(b) 6
(c) 7
(d) 8
(e) 9

3. An isosceles triangle always possesses at least two sides of equal length.
a. True
b. False

Answers and Explanations
1. d. Dividing both sides by 2 gives x = 4.
2. c. 7 * 7 = 49.
3. a. By definition, an isosceles triangle has at least two equal sides.
